extraction.notes: Target quarter is three months ended March 31, 2022. The FFO/CFFO reconciliation appears on printed page 53 (seq 58). Company reports no AFFO metric, so affo_total is null and affo_adjustments empty. Starting line is the net loss attributable to common stockholders (-15,396); the OP unit add-back (-5,816) is placed as the first FFO adjustment to reach the net loss attributable to common stockholders and unit holders (-21,212). Diluted share count 40,919,331 printed in full, converted to thousands (40,919.331). Check: -4,681/40,919.331 = -0.11 and 6,621/40,919.331 = 0.16, matching reported per-share figures. Zero-value lines (gain on sale of real estate investments, loss on extinguishment, weather-related losses) are shown as 0 in the 2022 column. Provision for credit losses, deferred interest income, other (income) expense and preferred stock accretion were categorized as 'other' since no listed category fits. Recurring capex: AFFO absent, so disclosed normally recurring capital expenditures of 889 (quarter, company total) from the capital expenditures table on printed page 52 (seq 57) recorded; total capex was 5,836 including redevelopment and routine items.
